name: Focused Shadowcraft Weapon
body:
Source Blood of Shadows pg. 22
Aura strong illusion CL 12th
Slot none; Price 13,000 gp; Weight varies
Description
This melee shadowcraft weapon is designed to act as a conduit for shadow magic, enhancing a spell’s potency when the weapon is involved in its casting. As a swift action, a focused shadowcraft weapon can be used to increase the caster level of any spell of the shadow subschool or spell with the darkness or shadowUM descriptors by 1.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, imbue with spell ability, major creation, shadow weaponUM; Price 6,500 gp
